off.quote: thou hast power of life and death: thou leadest to the gates of Sheol, and bringest up again
off.live: For you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again.

off.quote: into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin
off.live: For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject to sin.

off.quote: gather all the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning
off.live: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.

off.quote: brought to you exalted with glory, as children of the kingdom
off.live: For they departed from you on foot, and were led away of their enemies: but Yahuah (God) brings them to you exalted with glory, as children of the kingdom.

off.quote: he makes his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father
off.live: We are esteemed of him as counterfeits: he abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness: he pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed, and makes his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father.

off.quote: erred in the knowledge of Yahuah (God) … and those so great plagues called they peace
off.live: Moreover this was not enough for them, that they erred in the knowledge of Yahuah (God); but whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance, those so great plagues called they peace.

off.quote: Elohim (God) created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity. Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world
off.live: For Yahuah (God) created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity.

off.quote: he hath given … to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved
off.live: He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.

off.quote: when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brethren … did eat of the bread of the Gentiles. But I kept myself from eating
off.live: And when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brothers and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles.

off.quote: in the sight of the unwise they seemed to die... but their hope is full of immortality
off.live: In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,

off.quote: But they were troubled for a small season, that they might be admonished, having a sign of salvation, to put them in remembrance of the commandment of thy law
off.live: But they were troubled for a small season, that they might be admonished, having a sign of salvation, to put them in remembrance of the commandment of your law.

off.quote: For he that turned himself toward it was not saved by the thing that he saw, but by thee, that art the Saviour of all
off.live: For he that turned himself toward it was not saved by the thing that he saw, but by you, that are the Saviour of all.

off.quote: For it was neither herb, nor mollifying plaister, that restored them to health: but thy word, O Yahuah (God), which healeth all things
off.live: For it was neither herb, nor mollifying plaister, that restored them to health: but your word, O Yahuah (God), which healeth all things.

off.quote: For thou hast power of life and death: thou leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again
off.live: For you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again.

off.quote: Instead of which thou feddest thine own people with angels' food, and didst send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man's delight, and agreeing to every taste
off.live: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.

off.quote: For thy sustenance declared thy sweetness unto thy children, and serving to the appetite of the eater, tempered itself to every man's liking
off.live: For your sustenance declared your sweetness to your children, and serving to the appetite of the eater, tempered itself to every man’s liking.

off.quote: That thy children, O Yahuah (God), whom thou lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourisheth man: but that it is thy word, which preserveth them that put their trust in thee
off.live: That your children, O Yahuah (God), whom you lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourishes man: but that it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.

off.quote: Instead of which punishment, dealing graciously with thine own people, thou preparedst for them meat of a strange taste, even quails to stir up their appetite
off.live: Instead of which punishment, dealing graciously with your own people, you preparedst for them meat of a strange taste, even quails to stir up their appetite:

off.quote: But thy sons not the very teeth of venomous dragons overcame: for thy mercy was ever by them, and healed them
off.live: But your sons not the very teeth of venomous dragons overcame: for your mercy was ever by them, and healed them.

off.quote: And say not, I have sinned, and what harm has happened to me? for Yahuah (God) is longsuffering, he will in no wise let you go.
off.live: Say not, I have sinned, and what harm has happened to me? for Yahuah (God) is longsuffering, he will in no wise let you go.

off.quote: and the sparrows muted warm dung into my eyes, and a whiteness came in my eyes: and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not
off.live: And I knew not that there were sparrows in the wall, and my eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into my eyes, and a whiteness came in my eyes: and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not: moreover Achiacharus did nourish me, until I went into Elymais.

off.quote: praises the King of heaven
off.live: If you turn to him with your whole heart, and with your whole mind, and deal uprightly before him, then will he turn to you, and will not hide his face from you. Therefore see what he will do with you, and confess him with your whole mouth, and praise Yahuah (God) of might, and extol the everlasting King. In the land of my captivity do I praise him, and declare his might and majesty to a sinful nation. O you sinners, turn and do justice before him: who can tell if he will accept you, and have mercy on you?

off.quote: turn not your face from any poor
off.live: Give alms of your substance; and when you give alms, let not your eye be envious, neither turn your face from any poor, and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you.

off.quote: Accustom not thy mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One
off.live: Accustom not your mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.

off.quote: My son, in thy sickness... pray unto Yahuah (God), and he will make thee whole; leave off from sin, and order thy hands aright
off.live: My son, in your sickness be not negligent: but pray to Yahuah (God), and he will make you whole.

off.quote: alms doth deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin
off.live: For alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:

off.quote: was present when thou madest the world
off.live: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.

off.quote: A faithful friend is a strong defence... has found a treasure
off.live: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure.

off.quote: make[s] the needy eyes to wait long
off.live: My son, defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long.

off.quote: thou feddest thy own people with angels' food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man's delight
off.live: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.

off.quote: made... to rest upon the head of Jacob... among the twelve tribes did he part them
off.live: And made it rest upon the head of Jacob. He acknowledged him in his blessing, and gave him an heritage, and divided his portions; among the twelve tribes did he part them.

off.quote: O blessed are they which love thee, for they shall rejoice in thy peace... when they have seen all thy glory, and shall be glad for ever
off.live: O blessed are they which love you, for they shall rejoice in your peace: blessed are they which have been sorrowful for all your scourges; for they shall rejoice for you, when they have seen all your glory, and shall be glad for ever.

off.quote: it is not the growing of fruits that nourisheth man: but... thy word, which preserveth them that put their trust in thee
off.live: That your children, O Yahuah (God), whom you lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourishes man: but that it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.

off.quote: was brought into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life
off.live: He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Yashar'el (Israel) his judgments.

off.quote: Set not your heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity
off.live: Set not yours heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity.

off.quote: The countries marvelled at thee for thy songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations
off.live: The countries marvelled at you for your songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations.

off.quote: surely believe[d] those things which Jonas the prophet spoke of Nineve, that it shall be overthrown
off.live: Go into Media my son, for I surely believe those things which Jonas the prophet spoke of Nineve, that it shall be overthrown; and that for a time peace shall rather be in Media; and that our brothers shall lie scattered in the earth from that good land: and Jerusalem shall be desolate, and the house of Yahuah (God) in it shall be burned, and shall be desolate for a time;

off.quote: thou gavest them a burning pillar of fire, both to be a guide of the unknown journey
off.live: Instead of which you gavest them a burning pillar of fire, both to be a guide of the unknown journey, and an harmless sun to entertain them honourably.

off.quote: deemed... the circle of the stars, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world
off.live: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of Yahuah (God), and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;

off.quote: be a father to the fatherless
off.live: Be as a father to the fatherless, and instead of an husband to their mother: so shall you be as the son of the Most High, and he shall love you more than your mother does.

off.quote: thou feddest thy own people with angels' food
off.live: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.

off.quote: Yahuah (God) is patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them
off.live: Therefore is Yahuah (God) patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them.
